name: Variance Shadow Mapping for NeRFs
definition: A shadow rendering method for NeRFs that uses SGs to render cast shadows, inspired by variance shadow-mapping. It avoids cumulative transmittance of light along sampling points on shadow rays by comparing depth inconsistencies from light and camera views.
summary: Variance Shadow Mapping for NeRFs efficiently generates soft shadows by transforming depth statistics into continuous visibility values, avoiding expensive ray integration.
